notes: Minimum lot area / rear battleaxe column of Table 3B; used by C4.1.1-r2 and C4.1.1-r6. Transcribed from Chapter 3 p54; values identical to Chapter 2 Table 2B and current Table D grouped rows. The dwelling-type column and the 'only applies to single houses' footnote on the battleaxe and frontage columns are removed, so those columns now read as applying to grouped dwellings (ch3-089, verify). The R10-R25 average site areas are struck through as a flagged proposed change for Perth and Peel only (ch3-090; Information Sheet 5); kept operative with verify true. R80 site area provisions apply to grouped dwellings on lots coded R100, R160, LR, MR and HR.
